name: – Ralf Seekatz – § 1 – Am 1
title: REPORT on Banking Union – annual report 2024
part_text: 1. Acknowledges the progress made over the last 10 years through the establishment of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM) and Single Resolution Mechanism (SRM); notes that the BU will not be completed without the establishment of its third pillar, the European deposit insurance scheme; emphasises that every Member State has the right to decide whether to adopt the euro;
